title: Menus, Collected
blurb: Six restaurant menus, six different brands, one discipline: hierarchy you can read from a metre away. Some take illustration, some take brutal type — none of them take decoration for decoration’s sake.
alt: Collection of restaurant menu designs in different styles: illustrated, red bold type, and grid based
details: Each menu starts from the same grid, then the brand decides the voice.
Illustrated route for casual brands, typographic route for fast-casual.
Every file handed over print-ready with fonts outlined and a colour proof.
